about_the_game:
THIS DEMO IS A STANDALONE GAME AND TAKES PLACE 6 MONTHS BEFORE THE FULL GAME EVENTS

The Duskheath Museum is in mourning. Ezekiel Dunbridge, the curator, has been found dead. He had just received the latest pieces for his exhibition "Revelation", dedicated to the occult and communication with the dead. Museum employees reported seeing him losing his mind, then chanting in an unknown language until he gouged out his eyes before collapsing from a heart attack.

You play the role of the exorcist from the Cam-on-Rail company who has been sent to the scene. It should be a routine operation: the Cam-on-Rail system is well-versed in this type of situation. Your mission: to monitor the museum exhibits throughout the night and neutralize any anomalies or paranormal activity in the building.

DEMO CONTENT

  • The scenario takes place 6 months before the full game.

  • The game environment has been altered and offers a different experience. Some parts of the museum are closed, while others are exclusive.

  • Find the 50 anomalies, some are exclusive to the demo (compared to 100 in the full version).

YOUR MISSION: ERADICATE THE SPIRITS

Securely locked behind a 6-lock door, use the Cam-on-Rail system to monitor every nook and cranny. Find and photograph anomalies to exorcise them. Watch out for your battery limit.

COURAGE AND PATIENCE...

Pay attention to every detail, and find new anomalies as they occur. After each round, the system reveals the number of anomalies missed. For each oversight, one of the 6 locks on the seal protecting you is destroyed. To complete your mission, keep at least 1 lock until 8 am and eradicate the evil that haunts this place. We're counting on you to survive the 8 rounds of the night!

GAME DURATION

45-120 minutes

content_descriptors.notes: Creepy atmosphere, a few jumpscares, occasional bloodstain, death related content (skulls and bones)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Watch over the Duskheath Museum with a rail-mounted camera. Closed following the death of the conservator, your mission is to photograph the anomalies and exorcise the spirits that have taken possession of the premises. Can you survive the 8 rounds through these mysterious exhibition halls?
supported_languages:
English*, French
*languages with full audio support
